design.thesis: The feast program and the night watch: thirteen engraved artifacts from the novel's gala week — examination file, two printed programs, a war-map, two recovery handbills, a hinge plate, three desert interfaces, a nightmare vignette, a dawn-drills panorama, a joyride diptych, a last watch, a daylight bedroom — drawn in one engraving hand (ruled keylines, hatch families, stencil mono labels, one spot role + Manila) but never the same artifact twice. Feast-side plates crowd the frame as November deepens (p1c46 the densest composition in the cohort); desert-side plates thin toward silence (p1c52 the emptiest). The braid chapters (p1c46/p1c47/p1c51/p1c53 + hinge p1c45/p1c50) carry in-flow pure-CSS dividers because Chromium cannot paint SVG-sprite fragments through CSS content:/background: (cohort C probe) — so the sprite ships opener symbols AND divider/sub-plate symbols as supervisor-mergeable assets, while the reader-visible junctions are bounded CSS compositions (J2).
design.directions_considered: A) Uniform program-booklet plates for all 13 (rejected: the desert chapters would lie — they are starlight and argument, not paper; uniformity would also clone cohort C's document grammar). B) Character-portrait plates (rejected: the novel's faces are veiled, masked, wigged, greasepainted — portraiture would fight the prose's own concealments, and the brief's grammar is programs/menus/handbills). C) CHOSEN: artifact-per-chapter in one engraving hand — each plate a distinct printed/made thing from its pages (exam file, war-map, handbill, soup can, drills panorama, bedroom, interface scenes), feast register crowding as November deepens, desert register thinning toward p1c52's silence. Matches the brief's cohort grammar exactly, keeps the body calm, and gives the engineer 13 genuinely different compositional problems instead of one template with 13 captions.
design.frontend_design_review: Per skill://frontend-design: the boldness is spent in ONE place per chapter (the authored plate object); everything around stays quiet (scaffold, calm Newsreader body, Manila ink). Numbered markers (cup cones, cue strips) appear only where the prose itself counts; dividers encode strand/location information, never decoration. No cream/terracotta default, no SaaS cards, no gradient washes, no ALL-CAPS eyebrows above content — the mono stamp band is the brief's mandated document voice (brief's own words win), not a generic eyebrow.
